title: Coffee, Iced Latte, Decaffeinated, Nonfat, Flavored

content.title: About
content.content: Decaffeinated iced latte is a cold beverage made from espresso diluted with nonfat milk and flavored with natural extracts (e.g., vanilla, caramel). The caffeine is removed through a specialized process while preserving the coffee’s flavor profile.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaf coffee retains most of the antioxidants found in regular coffee.
Nonfat milk reduces calories but still provides protein and calcium.
Flavored versions often use natural extracts rather than artificial flavors.
Cold serving enhances perceived sweetness, so less sugar is needed.
Decaffeination can be done by water, CO₂, or solvent methods.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support vascular health.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Nonfat milk and the absence of added sugar make the drink suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Source of calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Even nonfat milk supplies calcium essential for bone health.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: A cold beverage encourages fluid intake, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Less stomach irritation
items.content: Without caffeine, the drink is less likely to cause heartburn or excess acidity.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People with lactose intolerance or casein allergy should choose a dairy‑free alternative.

items.title: Artificial flavor content
items.content: Some flavored versions may contain synthetic additives that can trigger sensitivities.

items.title: Residual decaffeination agents
items.content: Solvent‑based decaffeination can leave trace amounts of chemicals if not properly removed.

items.title: Reduced flavor depth
items.content: Lack of caffeine sometimes results in a less robust taste, which may disappoint strong‑coffee fans.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the decaf iced latte chilled over ice in a glass. Add a splash of sweetener, fresh fruit, or a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired. It can also be used as a base for smoothies, replacing part of the fruit with milk.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared drink refrigerated and consume within 24 hours. Do not freeze, as the milk texture may separate. Store milk and flavor extracts according to their package instructions.
